comments.note: resolveProjectPath() in path-validator.ts is clean and well-documented — JSDoc present with resolution rules, @throws annotation, and inline comments. The function is 30 lines with clear branching logic. Developer's 'no JSDoc' comment appears to have been written before completion.

Error messages are excellent: AMBIGUOUS error lists all candidate plan_paths and slugs so the user can immediately identify the right project; NOT_FOUND error includes the cwd_path and a hint to initialize. Clear and actionable.

validatePlanPathOrError remains used only by initializeProject in project-lifecycle.ts. When initializeProject is updated to use resolveProjectPath, this function can be removed. Low-priority cleanup; register it as a debt item.

The mechanic of passing both project_path and cwd_path: the implementation correctly prioritizes project_path (explicit branch runs first). The Zod schemas however don't enforce mutual-exclusivity — both can be provided simultaneously without error. This is acceptable given the documented priority order, but a future improvement could add a .refine() guard to make the intent explicit at the schema layer.
